name: HarnessRisk
titleZh: HarnessRisk：面向智能体外壳安全的全生命周期基准
summary: Organises harness safety into six operational phases and pairs a benign user objective with a risky condition across 128 sandboxed cases.
summaryZh: 把外壳安全拆成六个运行阶段，用 128 个沙箱用例，把「正常用户目标」与「风险条件」成对摆在一起。
keyFact: HarnessRisk (Bai et al., arXiv:2608.17597, 2026-08-18) splits agent-harness safety into six phases — harness configuration, capability extension, runtime operation, state persistence, action control and incident recovery — across 128 sandboxed cases.
keyFactZh: HarnessRisk（Bai 等，arXiv:2608.17597，2026-08-18）把智能体外壳安全拆成六个阶段——配置、能力扩展、运行时、状态持久化、动作控制、事故恢复——共 128 个沙箱用例。
whyItMatters: It moves the question from "is the model safe" to "is the thing wrapping the model safe", which is where most real incidents actually live.
whyItMattersZh: 它把问题从「模型安不安全」挪到了「包着模型的那层壳安不安全」——真实事故大多发生在这里。
title: HarnessRisk: A Lifecycle-Oriented Benchmark for Agent Harness Safety
